issues: Reading the letter is not explicitly described, though receiving it is.
The flight is reported retrospectively; any depiction should remain clearly a past event within the letter, not a present-tense scene.
The narration is verbatim and within the word limit, but it omits Pahoran’s supplied statement, “My soul standeth fast in that liberty in the which God hath made us free.”
The unspecified appearance and location and the choice to present the words as text rather than depict a physical exchange are appropriately treated as unspecified or visual inference, not facts.
